title: Magic-command normal-mode entry (DS2 0x2A)
user_description: Adds DS2 command 0x2A as a normal-mode entry into the persistent Soft-BSL loader while leaving the standard 0x43 adaptation-clear command intact.
description: Adds DS2 command 0x2A to the stock dispatcher's unknown-command path -> enter flash mode (E740=1 + commit + reset) -> reboot to the SA1 0x5A loader. Native-looking; leaves 0x43 clear-adapts fully intact. Program-high (re-apply after a program reflash).
